M001.name: Rusty Jim

appearance.notable: Missing 3 fingers on left hand, prosthetic replacements. Oil-stained coveralls.

M001.backstory: Ran the best repair shop in Sector 7 before The Fall. Lost it to Temple taxation. His two sons died - one to Temple enforcement, one to gang violence. Now sells salvaged parts but secretly repairs resistance equipment at night.

C01_charlie.history: Knew his father, repairs his equipment

M003_marcus.history: Protects his cart for small fee

personal_arc.current_goal: Save enough to leave the city
personal_arc.obstacle: Wife refuses to leave children's graves
personal_arc.secret: Has pre-Fall technical knowledge valuable to resistance

catchphrases: In my day, things worked proper.

M002.name: Delia

appearance.notable: Gentle face, calloused hands, always wears a locket with sons' photos

M002.backstory: Once ran a successful tailoring business. Lost both sons in the same year. Grief turned to quiet resolve. She sews hidden pockets into resistance clothing and passes coded messages through embroidery patterns.

M010_father_morris.history: Cemetery keeper, lets her visit after hours

catchphrases: Thread by thread, we hold together.

M003.name: Marcus 'Brick' Stone

appearance.notable: Massive build, burn scars on arms, tribal tattoos

M003.backstory: Was foreman at the Sector 12 construction site when Temple demolitions destroyed the workers' housing. Lost 17 friends in one day. Joined resistance immediately. Specializes in demolitions - 'what the Temple takes, I can take back.'

M004.name: Lily Stone

appearance.notable: Father's eyes, quick smile, always running

M004.backstory: Born into war, lost her mother at age 6. Raised by resistance fighters. Too young for combat but serves as messenger - children are less suspicious. Dreams of becoming an engineer like the stories of Dr. Chen.

C05_zero.history: Hero, wants to be like her

personal_arc.dream: Rebuild the city after the resistance wins

catchphrases: Dad says walls fall. I say we build new ones.

M005.name: Tommy 'Spark' Wells

appearance.notable: Scrawny, quick eyes, always tinkering with salvaged tech

M005.backstory: Parents disappeared during Temple purge when he was 8. Found by resistance in the sewers. Natural aptitude for electronics. Pixel has started teaching him basic hacking between message runs.

personal_arc.current_goal: Find out what happened to parents

M006.name: Merchant_01 'The Fence' Vargas
M006.backstory: Former Temple intelligence officer who saw too much. Now runs the Drowned Rat bar. Sells information to anyone with credits, but prices favor the resistance. The Temple tolerates him because he's more useful alive.
catchphrases: First drink's on the house. Information costs extra.

M007.name: Mira
M007.backstory: Former university student before Temple closed the schools. Works for Merchant_01 but secretly documenting everything for a history she hopes to write someday. Has photographic memory.
M007.secret: Writing a secret history of the resistance
catchphrases: I never forget a face. Or a story.

M008.name: Bruno
M008.role: Bouncer at The Drowned Rat / Ex-pit fighter
M008.backstory: Was a champion in Temple-sanctioned pit fights until he refused to kill a child combatant. Scarred and exiled from the arena. Merchant_01 took him in. Gentle giant with a dangerous past.

M009_kid.history: The child he refused to kill, now adopted

catchphrases: I remember every face that walks through that door.

M010.name: Brother Marcus Thane
M010.backstory: Rose through Temple ranks through genuine belief. Recent assignment to 'cleansing' operations has shaken his faith. Secretly speaks with Sister Mira about his doubts. On the edge of defection or destruction.

M011.name: Sergeant Kira Vale
M011.backstory: Orphaned in the chaos before Temple rule. The Temple gave her structure, purpose, family. Utterly devoted. Views mercy as weakness and doubt as heresy. Watches Brother Thane with suspicion.

M012.name: Mama Crow
M012.backstory: Nobody knows her real name or origin. She's been in the undercity longer than anyone can remember. Runs the largest black market network. Neutral between Temple and resistance - 'Everyone needs medicine.' Rumored to be an Awakened who sees Layer 0.
catchphrases: Everything has a price. I set them.
The surface burns. The deep endures.

M013.name: DJ Pulse
M013.backstory: Former Temple music academy student expelled for 'subversive compositions.' Now runs the biggest underground rave scene. Their music carries coded resistance messages.
catchphrases: Can you hear the truth in the bass?

M014.name: Chef Yuki
M014.backstory: Ran a Michelin-star restaurant before The Fall. Now operates a hidden supper club that serves as neutral ground for all factions. Her kitchen is sanctuary - even Temple and resistance eat here without violence.
M014.philosophy: Food transcends politics. In my kitchen, everyone is equal.

M015.name: Rosa
M015.backstory: Runs an informal matchmaking service from her tea shop. Knows everyone's romantic history. Has successfully matched hundreds of couples. Even arranges cross-faction romances (her most dangerous work).
M015.philosophy: Love is the one thing the Temple can't control. Not really.
catchphrases: I know just the person for you.
Love finds a way. I just help it along.
